workload: Dependent trained micro autoregressive successor stream; all contexts are training examples, not a transformer

native.measurement: Fresh native generation including isolated owner provisioning and worker startup; shared-host contended functional run.

next_token_contract: Checked full logits are public; lowest-index argmax supplies the next public one-hot input
inclusive_cost_scope: Fresh native pool generation+role load/import/TLS setup+private seed sharing+checked dependent sequence; native compilation and certificate/process provisioning separate. Sum of stage maxima, not one end-to-end stopwatch.
amortization: Exactly T fresh one-use rows consumed per layer and T fresh square masks. Divide pool generation by T actual dependent tokens, never by replay count.

clear_baselines.workload: One dependent fixed-length autoregressive stream; actual MLP, argmax and next one-hot input at every step
clear_baselines.resident_gpu_contract: GPU argmax/state update; no interstep host delivery. Primary GPU comparator.
clear_baselines.host_delivery_contract: All eight logits copied to CPU after every step; separate streaming comparator.

measurement: Actual shared-host CPU/TLS dependent stream. No online token batching or ideal-network projection. Native/CPU contention must be recorded separately.
provisioning: Public checkpoint fixture; model plaintext only supplied to native owner1, seed only to online owner0; each worker consumes only its role bundle. Same-user processes are not security domains.
